Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

141-5256-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5256-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
141-5256-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing a player to mill card(s).
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

5276-6495-6767.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Rescue Skiff from exile to the battlefield.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.
5276-6495-6767.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

586-2906-5258-5618-8095.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
586-2906-5258-5618-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

3259-6791-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6791-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6791-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token

176-413-3000.description:

Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

232-1235-5913-5940.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk with haste.

Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Return the Favor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1168-1479-2841-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1168-1479-2841-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Palinchron.
Repeat.

Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Kragma Butcher, targeting Kragma Butcher.

When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.

When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.

Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

813-957-3647.description:

Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.

Repeat each other turn.

Alternatively, you may only remove one +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler and sacrifice an Eldrazi Spawn instead.

Activate Lazav by paying {2}, choosing to have it become a copy of Putrid Goblin if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, or Strangleroot Geist otherwise.

Otherwise, Lazav's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lazav enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.

Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the life you gained.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{B}.

Activate Kiora by removing zero loyalty counters from it, untapping The Chain Veil.

Repeat from step 2.

957-1309-2034-4935.description:

Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.

When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.
